decisions.reason: The product remains close to the firm's established low-pile carpet range and has shown no negative signals, so the low cost of keeping the option open justifies retaining it while market uncertainty persists.

Although the hand-knotted wool silk carpet carries higher production costs, its premium niche still holds option value and demand uncertainty has not resolved enough to abandon it, so the firm keeps it with a slightly higher monitoring cost.

Because the firm already holds similar low-pile carpet options, the marginal option value of this duplicate is lower, but without negative results and with low keeping costs it is still retained for market coverage.
The corner bench builds directly on the established offer with low uncertainty and low cost to keep, so abandonment remains very unlikely.
As with the other low-pile carpets, the lack of negative signals and minimal cost of maintaining the option keep this product on the market while uncertainty about demand remains.
The swivel shell chair line offers broader option value through several models and has no negative results, so the firm keeps the line open to capture potential demand.
